text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "Naannoo weyna degaatti qamadii jallisiif yuuriyaan si'a lama kennama [S2, S3]. Kaffaltiin jalqabaa 1/3 (50 kg/ha) yeroo facaasaatti naqama [S2, S3]. Hambaan 2/3 (100 kg/ha) aramaa erga buqqistanii booda, yeroo qamadiin mowaaleda (tillering) jalqabu naqama [S2, S3]. Qamadiin kee ammaa sadarkaa tillering irra jira [C]. Yuuriyaan kan naqamu erga lafti bishaan dhugee booda, galgala sa'aatii 10:00 booda yeroo qilleensi qabbana'u biyyooyyee dhoqqee irratti [S2].", "confidence": "high"}
